name: auth_log
description: Parse auth.log or secure, including the rotated and gzipped files, into structured records: ssh acceptances and failures with the source address and key fingerprint, sudo commands with the working directory, su, session open and close, and account changes.

path.description: An auth.log or secure file, or a directory of them (rotated files are followed)

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring over the whole line

year.description: The year to apply to traditional syslog lines, which carry no year
